name: @viglet/shio-js
description: Shio CMS JavaScript workspace — console (shio-react), CDA client, React SDK, the page-section vocabulary, Universal Editor bridge, the Next.js starter generator and the example sites.

scripts.build:sdk: pnpm --filter @viglet/shio-client run build && pnpm --filter @viglet/shio-react-sdk run build
scripts.build:sections: pnpm --filter @viglet/shio-model run build && pnpm --filter @viglet/shio-sections run build
scripts.build: pnpm run build:sdk && pnpm run build:sections && pnpm run build:editor && pnpm run build:console && pnpm run build:examples
